# Practice exam: subtraction

This is a short practice exam for trying out the site before a real exam.

`main.c` reads two integers and prints their difference. Finish the function `subtract()` so it
returns **x − y**. Don't change `main()`.

## Sample runs

| Input | Prints |
|---|---|
| `7 3` | `7 - 3 = 4` |
| `3 7` | `3 - 7 = -4` |
| `0 9` | `0 - 9 = -9` |
| `-5 10` | `-5 - 10 = -15` |

## Using the IDE

- **Build & Run** (Ctrl+Enter) compiles and runs your program. Type the two numbers in the console and press Enter.
- Errors appear in the console; click one to jump to its line.
- **Run tests** checks your program on the sample runs above. Your instructor grades with more tests than these.
- Your work saves automatically in this browser.

## Submitting

Click **Copy all code**, then paste it into the answer box in the quiz tab. Submit the quiz before time runs out.
